references.text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened
When you spread out your hands, I hide my eyes from you; even when you make many prayers, I do not hear; your hands are full of blood. Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean
Behold, you fast only to quarrel and to fight and to hit with a wicked fist. Such fasting as you do today will not make your voice heard on high
Thus says the Lord: Practice justice, and show mercy and compassion to your brother
And when you stand praying, forgive if you have anything against anyone, so that your Father who is in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses
Or do you think that I have come to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but rather division
